- It sets `window.innerWidth` to 800 before mounting and restores the original width in a `finally`, so the test cannot leak the width to later tests.
- It no longer clicks the desktop drawer toggle. The chat-only page always shows the feed, so the test waits for `council-messages` directly.
- The assertions are unchanged: a council signal for the project brings in the new message, and the detail is re-read.

- 2026-10-09T10:52 council-office-floor: Council office: full-width multi-room floor, prop geodata and purposeful long-activity behaviour, proper pixel characters. Turn the council office into a full-width band showing a whole isometric office floor whose props carry geodata (footprints and interaction points), with properly drawn pixel characters that live a purposeful office life: long stays at their own desk, coffee, sofa, window, chats, all without walking through objects, and gather in the meeting room when the council is in session.
- 2026-10-09T10:37 council-office-rework: Council office rework: non-overlapping labels, wandering after replay pause, art matching the reference. Fix the three live QA failures of the council office: name labels overlap up to 85%, characters stay frozen after a replay is paused, and the room art renders tan/olive and tiny instead of the bright peach/yellow diorama with visible projector screen, glass door, bins and readable characters.
- 2026-10-09T09:52 council-office-art: Council office art pass: bright isometric cutaway diorama with outlines and detailed props (owner reference). Restyle the council office to match the owner's reference: a bright isometric cutaway room on a light background with a thick floor slab, two light walls with baseboard stripe, dark pixel outlines, a long meeting table with laptops and office chairs, projector screen, whiteboard, glass door, cabinet, bins, boxes and clutter, and properly coloured characters, with the whole room framed in view.
- 2026-10-09T09:46 council-office-qa-fixes: Council page: bounded wide header, bubbles/labels inside office, distinct seat colors, moderator notice. Fix the live browser QA defects of the council page: at 1280 px the unbounded header hides office, log and composer; speech bubbles clip at the office top and show raw markdown; name labels overlap and clip; two seats share a color; moderator messages have no presence; the reset button squeezes the project select at 375 px.
- 2026-10-09T09:37 council-office-characters: Council office: characters walk, sit, talk and gesture like people (no teleporting). Make the council office characters believable: they walk at a steady speed along paths around furniture instead of teleporting, sit in visible chairs at the table, stand up and talk with gesturing arms and typewriter speech bubbles, face and point at the seat they argue with, react while listening, and in free time stroll to office spots and do small actions (coffee, window, typing at a desk), with replay steps driving the same walked motion.
- 2026-10-09T08:59 council-office-live: Council page: always-on pixel-art three.js office with pixel-styled history and replay. Make the Council page an always-on isometric pixel-art office on three.js where seats (plus chair and owner) are blocky characters who speak at the meeting table with bubbles, face the seat they answer, wait seated, and wander when idle; next to it the conversation history is a pixel-art styled log linked to the office, with a replay that plays a past council message by message.
